prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Sign-in hints (+3.0% to +6.0%), preset customization fallback flows (+8.0%), interactive wait screen tips (+5.1%), and story screen sequence reordering (+2.9%) were helpful.
Most wait screen info updates and sign-in step reordering showed no clear effect.
Layout changes and new desktop screens showed no clear effect or significantly hurt performance (up to -9.9%).
Specific copy changes frequently hurt performance (up to -13.9%) or had no clear effect.
Predictions consistently overestimated positive impacts for lost tests while underestimating wins like story sequence reordering and sign-in hints.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: -1.2% over 2 test(s)
- adoption, new_flow: +2.6% over 3 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -3.8% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -4.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: -1.0% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: +2.9% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: -3.9% over 3 test(s)
- finish, layout: +1.4% over 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -7.8% over 2 test(s)
- home, new_flow: -2.0% over 1 test(s)
- home, new_screen: +3.0% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +1.5% over 5 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +3.1% over 3 test(s)
- sign_in, layout: -0.0% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -1.3% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 79.1%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 80.2%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 62.7%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 85.0%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.9%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, new_screen] Path Selection Story Recap Screen: Insert a short summary screen between story and choose_path highlighting companion possibilities before path selection. (why: Choose path completion is 79.1% with a high mean duration (514s), suggesting users need clearer narrative context before deciding.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Sign-In After Pick Friend Order Shift: Move the sign_in step to occur right after pick_friend so users select their pet before authenticating. (why: Users pick their pet concept first, increasing motivation to sign in and save their chosen pet.)
2: [home, new_flow] Interactive Waiting Progress Stage Flow: Replace the static waiting screen status with a dynamic progress indicator and animated mascot visual. (why: The waiting step has a long mean time (2336s). Active visual feedback keeps users engaged while generation completes.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Account Restoration Reassurance Hint: Add a prominent hint on the sign-in screen informing returning users that signing in automatically restores their existing pets. (why: Support mail highlighted 8 cases of users worried about missing pets after signing in again.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Readiness Background Notification Option: Enable background notifications on the waiting screen and update text reassuring users they can minimize the app. (why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s; allowing background notifications prevents users from abandoning long render processes.)
5: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Pet Customization Preview Hint: Add a hint to the path selection screen explaining that companion appearance can be customized in subsequent steps. (why: Users take an average of 514s on path selection; clarifying that choices are customizable reduces decision anxiety.)
6: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Quick Controls Intro Screen: Insert a new introductory screen right before home_intro that clearly demonstrates basic mouse controls for desktop pets. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control or hide pets, and finish step conversion is only 64.8%.)
7: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Custom Generation Fallback Hint: Add a hint on the photo upload screen assuring users that preset fallbacks are ready if custom photo processing fails. (why: Adoption has a 62.7% conversion rate, and support received emails about custom generation failing or looking unexpected.)
8: [finish, layout] Home Intro Checklist Layout Transition: Switch the home intro screen layout to 'checklist' format to guide users through initial setup actions. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% with a long mean duration (5815s). A checklist layout clarifies final completion steps.)

scores.note: New screens and layout changes consistently show poor performance or negative impact.

Sign-in hints strong performance history (+3.1%) and directly supported by user emails.
Wait info updates have modest historical gains (+1.5%).
Low cost hint addition to address decision time, though lacking direct support emails.
High evidence from support, but desktop new screens consistently hurt conversion (-7.8%).
Targets high drop-off step with strong email evidence and positive fallback flow history.
